spans.s: + म् यद्-अर्थ + म्, adv. for what reason,
+ नाथ यदु- + नाथ, m. a name of Kṛṣṇa.
+ भविष्य यद्- + भविष्य, m. a proper name, Pañc. 77, 9.

यद्,
 I. Relative pronoun; the base of the cases and of most derivatives is य, Who, which, what,
. In proportion, as each of which,

. Whoever, whatever, Hit. pr. d. 34, M.M.
 IV. With following interr. pronoun (किम्), Whoever, whatever. Pañc. i. d. 403.
 V. Two and more relatives may be combined with one verb; e. g. यद् येन युज्यते, What is fitting for something, Hit. i. d. 53, M.M.; यो ऽत्ति यस्य यदा मांसम्, When one eats the flesh of some (creature), Hit. i. d. 65, M.M.
 VI. यद्, acc. sing. n., a particle.
 1. As, since, because, Hit. pr. d. 8, M.M.; wherefore.
 2. That,

. It is often used as introduction to a direct sentence, Pañc. 175, 13. वदन्ति यद् अस्माकं राजा किं करिष्यति, ‘They say: what will the king do to us?’ 227, 7.
 3. With following वा, Or,

. With following अपि, Although, Pañc. i. d. 7.
 VII. येन, instr. sing. n., adv.
 1. In what manner,

. That, Pañc. 84, 17.
 VIII. यस्मात्, abl. sing. n., adv. Because, Hit. iv. d. 88;

.
 --Cf. probably ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, ἵνα, εἵνε-κα (= येन); Goth. ja in jabai.

य + दा (यद्), adv.
 1. When, at what time,
यदि (probably यद् + य, cf. आदि, आद्य), adv. If, Pañc. 229, 13; with [] following अपि, Although, Böhtl. Ind.
; with following वा, Or, Pañc. iii. d. 108.

यदु, m.
 1. The name of a king, Śiś. 9, 38.
 2. The name of a country.
 3. pl.
 a. The name of a people.
 b. The descendants of Yadu, Johns.
यद्-ऋच्छ् + आ (see vb. ऋ), f. Following one's own will or fancy; instr. ˚छया, Pañc. iii. d. 2 (without being stopped); by itself,
; by chance, accidentally, Vikr. d. 10; also यदृच्च-, as former part of a comp., by itself,
यद् + वत्, adv. In what manner, as, Pañc. ii. d. 62.

यादव, i. e. यदु + अ,
 I. m.
 1. A Yādava, or descendant of

. Kṛṣṇa.
 II. f. वी, Durgā.
 III. n. A stock of cattle.
 --Comp.

यादृश्, and यादृश् यादृश, i. e. यद्-द्रिश् and -दृश् + अ, adj.
 1. Which like, (क़ुअलिस्), Pañc. ii. d. 190.
 2. Which, what,
; Pañc. i. d. 236; Hit. i. d. 205, M.
. With following तादृश, Whoever, whatever, Pañc. i. d. 435.
